data.one_liner: Customizable alert and toast widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides FlashBar, FlashToast, FlashDialog and other alert widgets that can be shown anywhere in the app with rich customization options.
use_when: Need a customizable toast or snackbar replacement
Require modal alerts or persistent notifications
Want to control animation and position of alerts
avoid_when: Already using Flutter's built-in Snackbar for simple alerts
Only need very lightweight alerts without customization
strengths: Highly customizable with themes and builders
Supports multiple positions (top, bottom, center, toast, dialog)
Built-in animation and barrier tap handling
Fully Dart implementation, no native code
weaknesses: Not a state‑management or networking library

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar toast functionality with built‑in themes and easy configuration
